subject.title: fix(browser): keep screenshots private by default

question: Should browser screenshot image results be private by default for outbound channel delivery while still remaining available to the agent vision path?
rationale: The diff changes a security-sensitive default at the boundary between private page screenshots available to the agent and visible channel attachments, and the linked issue carries security/product-review labels.

options.title: Approve private-by-default screenshots
options.body: Land this shape after real channel proof shows browser screenshots reach the agent but are not auto-delivered to replies.

options.title: Require an explicit control surface
options.body: Ask for an opt-in parameter or policy surface if maintainers want existing automatic delivery preserved by default.

options.title: Pause for broader media policy
options.body: Hold this PR if screenshot delivery should be redesigned together with other sensitive tool-result media.

recommendation.title: Approve private-by-default screenshots
recommendation.body: Land this shape after real channel proof shows browser screenshots reach the agent but are not auto-delivered to replies.
